description: Search for flights between cities and airports. Find available flights with schedules, pricing, airline information, and seat availability for domestic and international travel. Use when the user wants flights between two places on given dates. Dates are DD.MM.YYYY. Results include search_url, which opens the same results on the site. When the user wants specific airlines, pass their IATA codes as airlines. For the cheapest day in a period, use flight_price_calendar first and search only the chosen day here. To give a booking link for the flights the user chose, pass their enuid values to flight_allocate.

airlines.description: Only flights with these airlines, as IATA codes (e.g., ['BA', 'TK']). Send only when the user asks for specific airlines.

name: flight_search
title: Search flights
